# snipeit_activity_reports (Data Source)

Reads rows from the Snipe-IT activity report (audit log), newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_activity_reports" "recent_checkouts" {
  action_type = "checkout"
  limit       = 25
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `action_type` (String) Filter by action type, e.g. `checkout`, `checkin from`, `update`, `create`.
- `item_id` (Number) Filter by item id (requires `item_type`).
- `item_type` (String) Filter by item type, e.g. `asset`, `user`, `license`, `accessory`.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of rows to return (default 50).
- `offset` (Number) Offset into the result set.

### Read-Only

- `rows` (Attributes List) Activity log rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rows))
- `total` (Number) Total number of matching rows on the server.

<a id="nestedatt--rows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rows`

Read-Only:

- `action_date` (String) Timestamp of the action.
- `action_type` (String) Action performed.
- `admin_name` (String) Name of the acting user.
- `id` (Number) Row id.
- `item_id` (Number) Id of the item acted on.
- `item_name` (String) Name of the item acted on.
- `item_type` (String) Type of the item acted on.
- `note` (String) Note attached to the action.
- `target_id` (Number) Id of the checkout target.
- `target_name` (String) Name of the checkout target.
- `target_type` (String) Type of the checkout target.
